title: AMD to invest up to $5 billion in Anthropic under AI infrastructure deal
slides: AMD bets $5B on Anthropic. Why now?

Anthropic's models run better on AMD hardware?

thread_text:
1. AMD's $5B bet.

Anthropic just got $5 billion from AMD. That's a direct challenge to Nvidia's AI monopoly.

2. Why hardware matters.

Anthropic's models are optimized for AMD chips. This isn't just funding — it's a technical alliance.

3. The cost twist.

Switching to AMD could cut cloud AI costs by 20%. That changes the economics of running large models.

4. The real test.

Performance parity with Nvidia? Not yet. But for many workloads, the savings outweigh the gap.

5. Check your bill.

Are you paying 20% more than you need to? Test your AI workload on AMD this week.

AMD just put $5 billion into Anthropic—and that could cut your cloud AI costs by 20%.
